title: react-world-map-extended: country data
description: Your own values to show in the map's details. An array of rows: a `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code) and the values. Not expressible here and checked by `validateCountryData`: the code must be a country on the map, and each country may appear only once (the first row is used).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (FR) or alpha-3 (FRA) code, any case. Names are not accepted.

infoLink.description: Optional. Shown as a link in the details when it is an http(s) URL.

additionalProperties.description: A value to show. The property name is the label.
